standards.applies_because: Digital device (15B) and any Wi-Fi/BLE transfer link (15C), US
Only if the camera has a radio (Wi-Fi/BLE photo transfer), EU
Lithium cell shipped with the product

risks.risk: Designing optics and image processing from scratch is out of reach for a first product
risks.mitigation: Start from an ODM camera module (sensor + ISP + lens) with its tuning; customise body, UI and colours

risks.risk: Flash capacitor (300 V class) in an openable body
risks.mitigation: Bleeder resistor, interlocked battery door, keep the ODM's flash board unchanged

risks.risk: Instant film supply: the film format decides the camera
risks.mitigation: Commit to an existing film format with a supply agreement before designing the print path

risks.risk: Dust in the lens / print path
risks.mitigation: Sealed lens module, gasketed print slot

tests.name: Drop 1 m, 6 faces
tests.method: Functional + image check after each drop

tests.name: Temperature rise at continuous recording / flash cycling

prototype.method: SLA resin body around the ODM evaluation board
steps: Order the ODM's evaluation kit (module + reference firmware)
Print the body in SLA resin around the kit, check lens and display alignment
Customise the UI / shutter behaviour in the ODM SDK
Drop and thermal checks on printed units
5 units to friendly photographers for 2 weeks
